paragraphs.text: Alberix , also known as the Trade Planet , is a planet from an unknown plane .

Alberix is a trading planet that debut in Mystery Booster 2 as a world enchantment . It introduced the planet keyword. It appears to be a rock floating in space with a city sprawling on top of it. The city has a large scale hanging over it as well as what appears to be statue of a face on the side. The planet appears to be floating in a space with stars and rocks seen in its background.
